g.text: ArthurRank6Convo2 begins.
I've been thinking. How many more of us do you think are out there?
Do you mean here in 1999, or in a broader sense?
"Us," meaning?
Both, I suppose. Here, now, in the past - in the future.
Protoframes. Here, or anywhere. Or any*when* I suppose.
Entrati made us with a purpose. With multiple purposes. It's clear it went past just the six of us.
At first, I thought he was making me "spare" warframes in case mine didn't come through the Helminth. Now, I'm not so sure.
I just wish I knew what he was up to. Or what his motivations really were, behind making more protoframes.
It made sense when there were just six of us.
Do you honestly believe his real motivation is to stop the Indifference?
Can we *really* trust him?
I don't know, honestly. I don't trust him as far as I can throw him. And without a warframe, my throwing arm is shit.
No. We can't trust his motives any more than we can trust his methods.
Yeah. I don't agree with his methods all the time. But yeah. He wants to stop that thing.
+5 Chemistry
He's trying to put the genie back in the proverbial bottle, if it can be done. And it's a messy process.
But we don't really have a choice, do we? All me and the kid can do is follow after him, cleaning up his messes.
Heh.
And we're the school caretakers, scrubbing the floors after him. Lovely.
Now that Kaya's got her own take on time travel, it might get easier for me to go back and forth.
But I'm staying here, so it's up to the kid, now.
That kid's a pain in the arse sometimes, but I do appreciate that.
Check boolean ArthurDating
It's nice to know when you pop off to the shops... you might actually come back... :/
Eh. We'll see. I know you well enough, love. And I know you don't know when to keep your head down.
true
Eh. We'll see. I know you well enough, Drifter. And I know you don't know when to keep your head down.
false
Check boolean ArthurDating
It's one of the reasons I adore you as much as I do. ;)
It's one of the reasons I put up with having you around. ;)
I owe her a great deal, giving me some semblance of peace of mind. :)
true
An emoticon! :D
false
Don't go getting all sappy on me.
false
Yeah, yeah. Don't go getting used to it. It still feels weird.
Mm, you know me. Crunchy on the outside, squishy in the middle. Like a stale version of those horrid pastries Amir and Velimir keep going on about.
Well, I'm flattered.
Tweebies?
Anyway. Back on topic. Sometimes I get this sinking feeling that Entrati has a bigger purpose for us all.
What makes you say that?
Yeah, you might be right.
Could that just be wishful thinking?
The amount of effort he's put in to creating us? And the fact that there are more than just the six...
What do you think it is? And what is he waiting for?
What do you mean?
You don't build weapons like these unless you know you're going to use them, mate.
<RETRO_EMOJI_SHRUG>
I wish I knew, on both fronts.
Sometimes it's hard to think that you're no longer "important."
Well, I'm just saying that... maybe you don't want to feel abandoned by him.
Unless you *know* there's going to be a war.
Maybe he needs an army? Maybe he's trying to find "the one thing" he thinks can defeat the Indifference. Maybe a lot of things.
Right...
That whatever he was here for, that whatever he did to you, still matters. Is still valid. That it didn't fail.
Then all we can do is be prepared if that happens.
It's possible. But Entrati also seems to be the kind of person to have contingency plans.
I don't know. Minerva and Velimir were telling me about the... "Cold War?" Sounds like people built a lot of crazy weapons and then never used them.
Can't help but think we're bullets in a gun. Meant to be used. Spent. And thrown away.
Chat ends.
And to be clear, you still matter.
And to be clear, you still matter to *me.*
+5 Chemistry
Maybe.
Fair counter point. But that's between countries, involving diplomacy. Moving parts.
I wish I could tell you. But I will do everything I can to stop that from happening.
You don't think you're done yet?
But to think your story ends here, without a part to play in how it all ends? That sucks.
But maybe it hurts to think you've been replaced by Arthur 2.0 out there somewhere.
But maybe you just want your sacrifices to still matter in a more cosmic sense?
Agreed.
Part of me does hope more of us exist out there. But if they do end up coming here? We might end up needing a bigger mall.
This is between a literal god and a man who thinks he's one.
I know you will. And we'll face that day together, and I have confidence in that.
No. You don't build weapons like these unless you know you're going to use them, mate.
That might be a part of it. If the Indifference is a reason I'm like this? And had to go through this?
Mate, I was ready to retire before I got sucked into this nonsense. Hardly.
Maybe. Maybe not. But how many people's sacrifices mean nothing, in life? Most.
And hope that if any more of us show up here? We won't end up needing a bigger mall.
Chat ends.
My money is on an inevitable collision. I don't think their egos would allow otherwise.
+5 Chemistry
I don't know. Minerva and Velimir were telling me about the... "Cold War?" Sounds like people built a lot of crazy weapons and then never used them.
It's possible. But Entrati also seems to be the kind of person to have contingency plans.
Then all we can do is be prepared if that happens.
I want a hand in bringing it down.
I am still astonished at your ability to utterly step in it, sometimes.
Maybe I'm just mourning the idea of a whole army of us out there, being made by a madman with no clear idea why. Or what for.
Chat ends.
You might be right.
I really hope you're wrong.
Check boolean ArthurDating
Fair counter point. But that's between countries, involving diplomacy. Moving parts.
Maybe.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
Chat ends.
Being told to suffer and being told to sacrifice - with no clear idea why. Or what for.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
Thanks, love.
true
Thanks, Drifter.
false
This is between a literal god and a man who thinks he's one.
Part of me does hope more of us exist out there. But if they do end up coming here? We might end up needing a bigger mall.
Agreed.
I don't want to be abandoned as a footnote in history. I want to put this skana straight up its arse.
Maybe that's the pill I'm having a hard time swallowing, mate.
For what it's worth? I hope I'm not.
For what it's worth? I hope I am.
Chat ends.
My money is on an inevitable collision. I don't think their egos would allow otherwise.
Chat ends.
And hope that if any more of us show up here? We won't end up needing a bigger mall.
I'll see what I can do. ;)
You 'n me both. And maybe Entrati while we're at it.
Chat ends.
There are no victors in war. Only survivors.
You might be right.
I really hope you're wrong.
Chat ends.
Heh.
+5 Chemistry
Chat ends.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
Check boolean ArthurDating
Now you're talking.
For what it's worth? I hope I'm not.
For what it's worth? I hope I am.
Thanks, love.
true
Thanks, Drifter.
false
